name: Explicit Radon Matrix Construction
definition: Constructs the explicit forward projection matrix $A$ for a parallel-beam CT geometry using ASTRA's strip projector, mapping voxel values to sinogram bins.
summary: Explicit Radon Matrix Construction computes the full forward projection matrix for parallel-beam CT, differing from iterative methods by materializing the complete linear operator for direct algebraic solutions at the cost of high memory usage.
